# Understanding Python Comments

#### Course: Learn Python Basics

## Understanding Python Comments

Let's look at another example:

```python
1# Print a number 
2print(6)
3print(8)  # Print another number 
4# Print third number 
5print(88.3)
```

This code has three comments:

```python
# Print a number 
# Print another number 
# Print third number
```

Python skips all of them when running the program. Only the print() lines are executed.

So this is the same as:

```python
1print(6)
2print(8)
3print(88.3)
```

The output will be:

```text
6
8
88.3
```

The comments help explain the code, but do not affect what the program does.
